notes.title: Bygone Dreams 1.0.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
Bygone Dreams 1.0.0.6 is now live. The build includes several critical bug fixes and a few quality of life improvements.


Bug Fixes
 Fixed a bug that caused Libra's elemental test to stop working if the player dies to it or leaves the area before the section is complete. 

 Fixed a bug that caused conveyor belts in Chapter 2 to apply too much force.




Gameplay Changes
 Stamina will no longer deplete out of combat.


 Slightly increased stamina recovery.


 Slightly decreased the stamina recovery delay.


 Most potions now last 90 seconds (up from 30 seconds).




Boss Tweaks
 Reduced the rate of frost buildup in the Isolde fight.
